title: Minimum Number of Increments on Subarrays to Form a Target Array
description: Calculate the minimum operations to transform an all-zero array into the target array using subarray increments.

steps.note: Initialize ops with the first element: 1.
Comparing target[1]=2 and target[0]=1. Since 2 > 1, add difference.
Comparing target[2]=3 and target[1]=2. Since 3 > 2, add difference.
Comparing target[3]=2 and target[2]=3. 2 < 3, no increment needed.
Comparing target[4]=1 and target[3]=2. 1 < 2, no increment needed.
